title: From rectangles to exact area
statement:
Use limiting left endpoints for $f(x)=2x$ on $[0,[$a]]$ to find the area.

[__________]{a}
hints: Keep the coefficient 2 in the height.
solution: The left sum is $(2([$a])^2/n^2)n(n-1)/2$. Its limit is $([$a])^2$.

feedback.message: Keep the coefficient 2 in the height.
